headline: The calmest day in the whole weather file is open until 11:00 - and Saturday and Sunday are both still blank.
body:
Two unresolved days now, not one. training.json is still stamped **2 Oct 21:31**, **58.9 hours** old, and five push windows have gone by empty - 3 Oct 07:50 and 21:30, 4 Oct 07:50 and 21:30, and this morning's. Saturday and Sunday carry no file and no wellness row. That is the laptop, never the watch: wellness ran complete through all four earlier droughts. So did yesterday's sea swim happen? The **25 km/h** window held all morning.

Today is calmer still and the best day in the file: **19 km/h** gust, **19 C**, open water **good**, and bike and run good in all three windows - the first day that is true. Water eases to 'care' after 11:00. Take it: **1,200-1,500 m at 2:20-2:35/100 m**, sighting every six strokes, no heart rate in the water.

Steady, not hard - HRV was **63 against a 69.1 mean** on Friday and nothing since has cleared that gate.

The forecast ends tonight. Wake the laptop, and the ankle answer has still never landed here.
